name: CAPSafe
summary: Evaluates situational household hazards, annotated by severity, at the level of single actions and of long-horizon plans. Plans are executed in a structured simulator that approximates AI2-THOR.
numbers: 9 LLMs; recognition above 90% at best; best safe success 78.19%, others below 65%

why.cog: Hazards inferred from object properties; several can co-occur.
